name: qlrisk_price_equity_option
title: Price a EquityOption
description:
Price one Equity Option (qlrisk EquityOption).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, notional=1000000, option_type=call (call/put), strike, quantity, ticker=SPX, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, spot, position.
Example: {"maturity": "1Y", "notional": 1000000, "ticker": "SPX"} gives NPV 88,408.50 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
